study.notes: STUDY: Kelly 2012, Cardiovasc Diabetol 11:64 (open access, Europe PMC PMC3434036, fetched by src/epmc_fetch_one.py into work/fulltext/companion/kelly2012_exenatide_metformin_prediabetes.txt), the full paper of the 2012 conference abstract in this group (abstract values identical); 3 month randomised (1:1, blocked by site) open label head to head trial of exenatide (5 ug twice daily for 1 month then 10 ug twice daily; dose_mg 0.01 per injection, twice daily) vs metformin (500 mg twice daily then 1000 mg twice daily) in 50 adults with abdominal obesity and prediabetes (IFG, HbA1c 5.7% or more, or IGT), two sites in Minnesota; n 25 per arm in Tables 1 and 2; primary endpoint reactive hyperaemia index (endothelial function), the biomarkers here are secondary (prespecified_endpoint FALSE); 13 weeks entered for 3 months; route arm_sds: mean change (SD) per arm from Table 2 with the P value of the ANOVA group by time interaction (the prespecified analysis), baseline mean (SD) per arm from Table 1; the Table 2 column headed Difference (M - E) holds exenatide minus metformin by its values (-0.8 minus -0.4 = -0.4 for BMI), so the contrast sign is read from the arm changes, not the label; pct_weight_change -1.15 computed by the session from BMI (weight not reported; percent change of BMI equals percent change of weight at constant height): exenatide 100*(-0.8)/35.3 = -2.27, metformin 100*(-0.4)/35.8 = -1.12, placebo corrected -2.27 - (-1.12) = -1.15 percentage points; industry_funded FALSE: funded by the Minnesota Medical Foundation and the United Hospital Foundation per the Funding section (study drug supply not stated); rob_overall some_concerns

json.design: randomised (1:1, blocked by site) open label head to head trial, exenatide vs metformin, 3 months, 50 randomised, two sites
json.reason: full paper of the group's 2012 abstract fetched from Europe PMC (open access); replaces the abstract read of the same group (2 rows, identical values) with 10 rows carrying baselines
other_markers: visceral and subcutaneous fat by CT in 14 patients (pre and post means per arm, n per arm not given)

rob.justification: S (full paper): blocked randomisation by site stated, allocation concealment not described (D1); open label (D2); Tables 1 and 2 report n 25 per arm at both times, no withdrawal described (D3 low); laboratory and automated measurements (D4 low); no registration or protocol cited, the ANOVA interaction is stated as the prespecified analysis (D5)

doubts: weight is not reported; pct_weight_change derived from BMI with the arithmetic in the study notes
CRP assay is a standard ELISA, recorded under hsCRP
the Difference column label (M - E) contradicts its values (E - M); the contrast is taken from the arm changes
